title: MrFEG's Throwable Spawn Eggs
description: This Mod is used to make every single spawn egg (including those from other mods) dynamically throwable
body:
![MrFEG's Throwable Spawn Eggs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e89672a52dd9c7a4d3e9bd3b3f84d8a0acde883f.png)
This **mod** transforms the standard, static **spawn eggs** in Minecraft into dynamic, **projectile-based** items. Instead of simply clicking to place a mob, you can now throw the egg—mimicking the behavior of the classic throwable egg—to spawn the mob exactly where the egg lands.
